channel.title: Resources :: FAU Cyber Security Club
channel.description: This is where you come to find things. Tools, learning material, reference guides — the good stuff that actually helps when you sit down and try to do something real. Here is the honest truth though: nobody is going to hand it to you, and that is fine. The resources here exist to point you in a direction, but whether you actually go anywhere is entirely up to you and what you do with your own time. The people who really get good at this are the ones who go home and keep going. Meetings are a starting point, not the whole picture.
